edits.before: - LeBlanc Distortion: matchup-defining — Dash with a four-second return window — punish the return spot, and remember she is broke after it. Check it before every step-up. - E Aegis Assault is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
